newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pioneer shares in active trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pioneer shares in active trade.

text.p: Shares in building materials group Pioneer International Ltd featured high on turnover lists on Wednesday with nearly seven million shares traded.
The bulk of the trade was in three lines specialled through Merrill Lynch -- one line of three million shares, one of two million and one of one million, all at A$3.92 per share.
Brokers said the trade appeared to be normal institutional business. By 2.35 p.m. (0330 GMT), Pioneer shares were four cents higher at A$3.95 on turnover of 6.9 million shares.
